description: The figure is a stacked bar chart illustrating the number of experts allocated across 24 indexed positions, with each bar decomposed into three groups labeled G0, G1, and G2. The horizontal axis contains the categories as integers from 1 to 24 in ascending order (no explicit axis label shown), and the vertical axis is labeled “Number of Experts” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10 with evenly spaced tick marks at intervals of 2. Each stacked bar uses blue for G0, green for G1, and yellow for G2 (as indicated by the legend centered at the top). Visually, G0 (blue) is a constant base segment of approximately 1 expert for every index from 1 through 24. The G1 (green) segment varies by index, appearing around 4 at index 1, 3 at index 2, 2 at index 3, 3 at indices 4–5, 2 at index 6, about 1 at indices 7 and 10–15, about 2 at indices 8–9 and 16–18, about 3 at indices 19–22, and about 1 at indices 23–24. The G2 (yellow) segment also varies, appearing around 4 at index 1, about 4 at indices 2 and 4, about 3 at index 5, about 3 at index 3, about 2 at indices 6, 8, 9, 10, and 16–18, about 1 at indices 7 and 11–15, about 2 at indices 19–22, and about 1 at indices 23–24. Total stacked heights therefore range from roughly 3 experts (e.g., indices 7 and 11–15 and 23–24) up to roughly 9 experts (index 1), with no special highlighting, annotations, or sorting beyond the natural numeric order of the x-axis.
